summary: Compressed the threshold-cliff smoothing and graduation calibration memo into a tighter ladder-first note.
major_judgments: Humans remain the default direct tax persons, while current LLM-shaped systems stay in controller-first tax logic rather than direct civic subjecthood.
Tax visibility is part of tax justice: smooth collection is acceptable only when burdens, offsets, triggers, and proceeds remain legible enough to reconstruct, contest, and compare with alternatives.
